fold_test.about: real-panel fold test on the GF-D21 tail fold gauge (concept_gf2.md 2.4): the pass line read by the drawings and the design document. GF-2.1 values (verified 2026-11-16): the gauge slot is g_bend, so the GF-2.0 gauge (3.00) is not valid for GF-2.1

fold_test.rule: panel held at its nominal position by the gauge, each tail folded over the gauge nose: a 0.80 feeler passes between the tail's outer surface and the gauge face / nose over the whole tail width, i.e. the tail's outer surface lies within 2.43 of the panel edge; record the largest feeler that passes (0.05 steps)
fold_test.basis: budget (g_bend note): needed gap = tail extent + clearance 0.45 + panel position 0.31 RSS; with the gap = the slot 3.23 the tail may extend 2.472, i.e. feeler 0.758 exactly; 0.80 is the next 0.05-step leaf at or above it (safe side)
fold_test.assumed_tail_note: straight tail_straight_l0 0.5 + inner radius tail_R_in_min 1.5 + thickness tail_t 0.30 = 2.30 -> passes with 0.13 to spare (gap 0.93 at the assumed tail)
fold_test.pass: border 19.0 holds by the budget: needed gap <= 2.43 + 0.45 + 0.31 = 3.188 <= g_bend 3.23 (reserve 0.042) <= limit 3.29 (border 19.0 - bezel 9.51 - land 6.20; reserve 0.102). Measured in 3D (GF-2.1) a tail up to 2.75 keeps >= 0.45 at the RSS position and up to 2.79 keeps > 0 at the full worst case (slopes TFT 0.82 / CTP 0.94 per mm); the concept's full-worst-case 0.45 holds only up to 2.309 (CTP margin 0.009 at GF-2.1), so passing does NOT guarantee that intent - no 0.05-step feeler can, because the assumed tail (2.30) must pass
fold_test.fail: measured tail extent d = gauge slot 3.23 - largest passing feeler; needed gap g = d + 0.45 + 0.31; border = bezel 9.51 + g + land 6.20, where the land is bead_edge 0.9 + bead_w 4.0 + bead_pocket_min 1.0 measured to the break edge + land_break 0.3 (A1 is measured to the break edge on the land plane). Border 19.0 holds while g <= 3.29 (g_bend raised to g); above that border = 9.51 + g + 6.20 (e.g. 19.5 covers g <= 3.79)
fold_test.land_note: GF-2.0 used a land of 5.9 (A1 to the pocket face); the rule is measured to the break edge, so the land is 6.20 (5.9 + the 0.3 break): at GF-2.0 that limit was 2.79 < the modelled 3.00, consistent with the GF-2.0 bead FAIL (0.79 on the land plane)

cad_rules: Drive every Z level from the expressions in derived_levels.expressions; never type the evaluated numbers into the model.
glass_t changes only the levels in front of the panel (Z_GLASS_FRONT .. Z_TUBE_TOP); everything at Z >= Z_FORMEX_FRONT is frame v2 geometry.
Step wall (s 0.4 .. 2.9 from the glass edge) is one body from Z_SHEET_BACK to Z_STEPWALL_BACK in every case; union it with the lip, the flange plate and the land plate.

Level snap: if |Z_FLANGE_BACK - Z_LANDPLATE_BACK| < 0.5 (glass_t 1.1 gives 0.10), extend the flange back to Z_STEPWALL_BACK (flange 2.6) so no 0.1 mm step face is created; the stud tube top follows (Z_STEPWALL_BACK + tube_h).
At glass_t 1.1 the recess floor (Z_LAND) lies only 0.10 behind the flange front: keep both faces; they are separated by the step wall, not adjacent.
Lip, seat ring, corner pads, glass recess and pips are formed in the A (fixed) half; parting line on the flange outline in the flange-front plane; single pull Z, no slides.
Tape strips are straight (4 pieces) and end tape_margin before the corner pads F1-F4 (GF-2.0: there is nothing at F5-F8).
Fastener slots F1-F4 are stadiums slot_w x slot_l at the flange front, 0.5 deg draft (wider to the back), long axis = slot_axis (towards the glass centre).

GF-2.0: Tail pocket x 38.9 / 167.7, bottom face 147.70 (R1.5): bend-gap slot y 119.0 .. bend_y1 open front to back; behind the bridge a floor = land-plate back (to the step-wall back) and the flange plate (Z_FLOOR_LOW); bottom wall = outer wall, flush with the flange edge.

GF-1.1: fastener counterbores 7.4 x 9.0 stadium (slot + 1.0 per side) coaxial with each F1-F4 slot, floor 1.6 above Z_SHEET_BACK (in the pad), R0.3 floor round, 1 deg; the 5.4 x 7.0 slot continues below (GF-2.0: F1-F4 only).

GF-1.1: annular coring groove round every fastener tube from the back, r 6.2-7.5 at the tube top, 3.3 deep, R0.4 floor rounds, 1 deg; the M4 washer sits on the dia-12.4 seat, the M5 rivet backing washer (dia 15) does NOT bridge the groove when centred: its edge lands on the groove's outer edge (r 7.5) and it bears ~88 mm2 on the dia-12.4 seat inside the groove (97-107 off-centre).
GF-1.1: H6 corner cell: cell wall jogged to leave the tail wall 1.1 at Z_PCB, R2.5 corner arc into the boss; no solid fill (thick-section rule: inscribed sphere <= 5.0 everywhere).
GF-1.1: frame outlines are glass-rectangle offsets with corner R_frame + s (R_frame 6.0); the glass corner is R_glass 6.25 and the sheet cut-out corner R_cut 7.55.

GF-1.1 round 3 (moulding): the lip top, the lip faces, the seat ring, the pads (F1-F4 hard-stop faces) and the land are exclusion zones for gates, ejector marks and parting lines; vent witness on the lip top is allowed only if flush within 0.02 (toolmaker to propose); this supersedes 'vents at the lip top every ~50 mm' in the concept text (concept.md).

GF-2.0: one driving border (all four sides); glass_y1 = pw_y1 + border; g_bend drives the bridge pocket face (bend_y1 = panel_y1 + g_bend at Z_LAND); flange bottom = flange_y1_bottom (flush with the bottom wall).

GF-2.1: bridge = land plate + step wall + flange plate over the tail span; nose R bend_nose_R on the land-plate back x pocket face (B side), land_break 0.3 x 45 deg on the land x pocket face (A side); slot faces 1 deg; the bend-gap slot is the only through-opening at the bottom. Its shut-off A/B is NOT a flat face at Z_LAND: the parting runs on the bridge side at the top of the land break (y 122.235, Z_LAND + land_break = -10.12) and on the front side at the shelf corner (y 119.00, Z_SEAT -4.60), so it rises 5.52 over the 3.235 slot width. Buildable form: an A-side ledge 3.235 x 0.3 across the slot at the break level, then a telescopic shut-off face along y 119.00 rising to Z_SEAT, >= 3 deg on that face (no part face below Z_SEAT there; up to 30.4 deg fits in the slot); stepped steel angles B 91 deg / A 135 deg at the break top, no knife edge (a straight shut-off from the break top to the shelf corner would leave a 31.4 deg B-steel knife edge; a flat shut-off at Z_LAND makes the break an undercut for B with a 45 deg knife edge).
